movie_title: Talking about social media 📱👍❤️ Real Easy English: Episode 8
introduction: Learn how to talk about your social media habits in simple English. Visit our website for more 👉 htt

vocabulary.definition: to have a feeling of not liking something
vocabulary.example: The reason I like social media is actually the reason I dislike it as well.

vocabulary.definition: causing a strong and harmful need to regularly have or do something
vocabulary.example: Social media can be very addictive and you can waste a lot of time watching videos.

vocabulary.definition: used to emphasize the certainty of an action
vocabulary.example: I think definitely I use social media too much.

vocabulary.definition: to talk to someone you haven't seen for a long time in order to find out what they have been doing
vocabulary.example: I use social media to catch up with friends who live far away.

vocabulary.definition: having or showing a sensible and practical idea of what can be achieved or expected
vocabulary.example: If I'm being realistic, I will probably continue using my phone in the same way.

vocabulary.definition: the state of being reliably true or valid
vocabulary.example: Using social media definitely brings certainty to staying in touch with friends.
